<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty erased early gains to trade significantly lower, pressured by persistent FII selling, high crude oil prices, and rising US bond yields.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Banking Sector Pressure:</strong> The Bank Nifty index declined over 500 points as investors reacted to RBI liquidity tightening measures and a surge in domestic 10-year bond yields to three-year highs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I26</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy Outlook:</strong> Analysts warn that persistent inflation risks, potentially reaching 6-7%, may force the RBI to implement further repo rate hikes of 100-150 basis points.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency Intervention:</strong> The Indian rupee rallied by nearly 1% against the dollar following fresh RBI measures aimed at curbing volatility and supporting the currency.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W18</a></span></li>
</ul>
